purpose: Sequential controlled small experiments to identify Nikon failure mechanisms, not four controller iterations
metric: center absolute PTTD RMS + edges difference from corrected bias, evaluated at0,+/-0.1mm, each<0.07waves
training: Long training stays stopped; neural weights frozen; offline command optimization is explicitly an oracle diagnostic
development_cases: Original11 plus original validation first8rows/group (24); cases never filtered by success
confirmation_cases: Original validation next8rows/group (24), reserved until round4; not a fresh independent test population
round1: Isolate loss shape/scale versus physical inverse conditioning using equal32 Adam command steps, plus separately labeled4-step oracle Gauss-Newton
round2: Use round1 findings to separate measurement noise, weak modes and nominal linearization
round3: Use round2 findings to isolate early stopping/feedback merit from estimator/direction error at fixed feedback budget
round4: One mechanism-driven correction and fixed confirmation; retain failures and do not tune thresholds
